label: TFG::ALK

sections.text: TFG encodes a coiled-coil protein involved in protein export from the endoplasmic reticulum.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.
The fusion joins an amino-terminal partner to the retained ALK kinase, producing abnormal ALK signaling. TFG::ALK is documented in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor.
Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in patients aged at least 1 year.
